name: Predictive Input
description: Holds a click back a few ticks when clicking right now would kill you.

lookahead.name: Lookahead (ticks)
lookahead.description: How many ticks past the click to simulate when checking for a crash. Higher is safer but heavier.

wave-release.name: Check wave releases
wave-release.description: Also hold back wave releases that would clip a hazard.
